summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of Bragg Gaming Group's annual meeting. Director Matevž Mazij failed to receive a majority of votes cast (55.67% withheld) and, per the company's majority voting policy, offered his resignation. He remains a director until the board acts or 90 days elapse. Other directors and auditors were elected. This is not a routine meeting notice; a director's forced resignation under majority voting rules constitutes an abrupt governance event, meeting the 'Management Changes' criteria for a special situation. Watch for board acceptance or replacement timeline.
